85229709cdc6f0eb.zh: 申请人提出了什么要求？

3ba297ecd61312ae.en: The scenario assumes an admissible complaint to a superior officer, with no grounds for refusal. Calculate the review deadline; do not promise a date for actual debt recovery.
3ba297ecd61312ae.zh: 题设中的上级申诉已符合受理条件，且不存在拒绝受理的理由。计算的是审查期限，不应承诺实际追回债务的时间。

6142f44f614da8b8.en: Bailiff service specialist preparing materials for the authorised supervisor
6142f44f614da8b8.zh: 为有权主管准备材料的司法执行机关工作人员

f6dd734ef97e3907.en: Refer the complaint to the authorised supervisor, monitoring the special deadline and any grounds for suspension.
f6dd734ef97e3907.zh: 将申诉提交有权主管审查，并跟踪特别期限及是否存在中止理由。

21cf4981f949ac94.en: Set the standard deadline of 30 calendar days.
21cf4981f949ac94.zh: 按常规确定30个自然日的期限。

cbe630034c1eb294.en: Promise to recover the debt within ten days.

23942df5a09a5d12.en: A complaint is not an ordinary letter

f6cba15f14624243.en: Read the general rule for counting days in Article 15 of the same law.
f6cba15f14624243.zh: 阅读同一法律第15条关于按日计算期限的一般规则。

262fcc11b922c108.en: Count every day as a calendar day.
262fcc11b922c108.zh: 将所有天数均按自然日计算。

6ec9471cf42af660.en: Assistant: ‘Article 126 does not say working days, so it means ten calendar days.’
6ec9471cf42af660.zh: 助手说：“第126条没有写工作日，所以是十个自然日。”

3397143cdc42eb08.en: Check the entire received package and the required signature.
3397143cdc42eb08.zh: 核查收到的整套材料及必需的签名。

0f11d0ea277f0f45.en: Establish that the special procedure applies, rather than the general removal of anonymous letters.
0f11d0ea277f0f45.zh: 确定应适用特别程序，而不是按一般方式删除匿名信件。

50a91fd586f5a4b7.en: Prepare a reasoned ruling concerning the identified formal defect.
50a91fd586f5a4b7.zh: 针对所指出的形式缺陷，拟定说明理由的决定。

8cd529950ee37371.en: Explain how to submit properly and appeal, without promising an outcome.
8cd529950ee37371.zh: 说明如何按规定重新提交及提出异议，但不承诺处理结果。

dfeed452e41f1169.en: Record the subsequent receipt of a signed package separately.
dfeed452e41f1169.zh: 另行登记之后收到的已签名材料。

b23accbd66f07b02.en: Sign the complaint in place of the applicant.
b23accbd66f07b02.zh: 代申请人在申诉书上签名。

24c84810d6dcd488.en: Declare the allegations false and prohibit future submissions.
24c84810d6dcd488.zh: 宣布申诉理由不实，并禁止今后提交。

ffb8defe07f16951.en: All people, documents and events in this case are fictional. This is a paper complaint to a superior officer under Federal Law No. 229-FZ, not a submission through an identity-verified electronic service. None of the received pages bears the applicant’s or representative’s signature. The applicant’s identity and address are known, and the package contains no other signed documents. Within this assessed task, the complaint’s format has already been established; you may not correct it on the author’s behalf.
ffb8defe07f16951.zh: 本案所有人物、文件和事件均为虚构。这是依据第229-FZ号联邦法律向上级提出的纸质申诉，并非通过实名电子服务提交的诉求。收到的任何一页上都没有申请人或代理人的签名。申请人的身份和地址已知，材料中也没有其他已签名文件。本计分任务已明确申诉的提交形式，不得替作者修改。

33bf968792395ef6.en: Part 2 of Article 125 and Article 15 of Federal Law No. 229-FZ. First identify the triggering event.
33bf968792395ef6.zh: 第229-FZ号联邦法律第125条第2款和第15条。首先确定起算事件。

435a5e298ff20699.en: Part 2 of Article 125 and Article 15 of Federal Law No. 229-FZ
435a5e298ff20699.zh: 第229-FZ号联邦法律第125条第2款和第15条

a8ac8ed05db5e4fe.en: Latest date for a ruling refusing consideration on the merits
a8ac8ed05db5e4fe.zh: 作出拒绝实体审查决定的最迟日期

8b449ac80e3cc3d3.en: In the base case, the complaint met the formal requirements. Here, a procedural question about its form has its own deadline; whether the underlying violation is proven is not assessed.
8b449ac80e3cc3d3.zh: 基础案例中的申诉形式符合规定。此处处理的是具有独立期限的形式程序问题，不判断所指控的实体违法是否得到证明。

db93c89dbe179fe0.en: Failure to meet the requirements of Parts 1 and 2 of Article 124, including signing a paper complaint, is grounds for a ruling refusing consideration on the merits. The ruling must be issued no later than three days after receipt of the complaint. It does not determine whether the bailiff’s actions were lawful on the merits and may be appealed. Days are counted under Article 15.
db93c89dbe179fe0.zh: 不符合第124条第1款和第2款的要求，包括纸质申诉缺少签名，可构成拒绝实体审查的决定依据。该决定应在收到申诉后三日内作出。它不对执行员行为的实体合法性作出判断，且可以被申诉。天数按第15条计算。

d61aa1bf24b5e49b.en: Sergey confirms that he accidentally omitted the signature. He did not authorise the reception officer to sign the complaint on his behalf.
d61aa1bf24b5e49b.zh: 谢尔盖确认签名是无意遗漏的。他没有授权接待人员代其签署申诉。

c28986d7263427b7.en: The complaint identifies the bailiff, enforcement case, allegations and demands. The surname is printed, but the signature field is blank. There is no separate signed attachment.
c28986d7263427b7.zh: 材料注明了被申诉的执行员、执行案件、申诉理由及要求。姓氏已经打印，但签名栏空白。没有另附已签名文件。

755d0578aae3decb.en: The unit received only the three pages of Ж-84 on {{received}}. No signed original, power of attorney accompanying the complaint, or electronic signature was received.
755d0578aae3decb.zh: 该部门于{{received}}仅收到Ж-84的三页材料。未收到已签名原件、随申诉提交的授权委托书或电子签名。

0cb231f9e544fa80.en: The paper complaint lacks the required signature; this is not a finding on the substantive lawfulness of the bailiff’s actions. In the base case, the complaint met the formal requirements. Here, a procedural question about its form has its own deadline; whether the underlying violation is proven is not assessed.
0cb231f9e544fa80.zh: 纸质申诉缺少必需的签名；这不是对执行员行为实体合法性的结论。基础案例中的申诉形式符合规定。此处处理的是具有独立期限的形式程序问题，不判断所指控的实体违法是否得到证明。

8640934b5792696a.en: The paper complaint lacks the required signature; this is not a finding on the substantive lawfulness of the bailiff’s actions.
8640934b5792696a.zh: 纸质申诉缺少必需的签名；这不是对执行员行为实体合法性的结论。

000879e238fd8226.en: A printed surname always substitutes for a signature.
000879e238fd8226.zh: 打印的姓氏在任何情况下都可代替签名。

b3777c8181d5cadd.en: The missing signature proves that the bailiff acted correctly on the merits.
b3777c8181d5cadd.zh: 缺少签名证明执行员的实体行为正确。

73815733304e62ff.en: A new signed copy arrives later. An officer suggests not opening it because the previous copy was already refused.
73815733304e62ff.zh: 后来收到了新的已签名副本。工作人员建议不要打开，因为之前的副本已被拒绝受理。

9c63dd5c9f1fbc55.en: Examine the new submission, checking the time limit, authority and form; the previous defect does not automatically carry over.
9c63dd5c9f1fbc55.zh: 审查新提交的材料，核查期限、权限和形式；先前的缺陷不能自动沿用。

b5bf83a2549c965f.en: Permanently stop accepting this citizen’s complaints.
b5bf83a2549c965f.zh: 永久停止接收该公民的申诉。

a8a00b4afd95ca4a.en: Automatically uphold the complaint now that it has a signature.
a8a00b4afd95ca4a.zh: 既然现在有了签名，就自动支持申诉。

b77d84a019c22723.en: Delete all subsequent submissions from the applicant.
b77d84a019c22723.zh: 删除该申请人今后提交的所有诉求。

85170c2708573ac7.en: Reject the complaint on the merits solely because of its form.
85170c2708573ac7.zh: 仅因形式问题，在实体上驳回申诉。

bb4d24d0db34c4f6.en: Find the legal basis for this action: prepare the ruling on a formal defect provided for in Article 125, without deciding the complaint on the merits.
bb4d24d0db34c4f6.zh: 查找下列行动的法律依据：依据第125条针对形式缺陷拟定决定，而不对申诉作实体判断。

9f370422210db651.en: I was told that my complaint about the bailiff would not be considered on its merits. But my surname is printed at the end! I brought a paper copy and forgot to sign it.
9f370422210db651.zh: 他们说不会对我针对执行员的申诉进行实体审查。可我的姓氏明明打印在末尾了！我带来的是纸质副本，只是忘了签名。

55c87acb6f20d296.en: Deciding whether to consider a complaint to a superior officer under Article 125.
55c87acb6f20d296.zh: 依据第125条决定是否审查向上级提出的申诉。

547a55d26fecaf84.en: On paper, not through an electronic service.
547a55d26fecaf84.zh: 以纸质方式提交，而非通过电子服务。

415781a4365fc660.en: At the end, but I did not sign it.
415781a4365fc660.zh: 应在末尾，但我没有签名。

4ff1eb3fd4ab3c3b.zh: 没有，清单已列出全部材料。

e8a2f81b4d99eda7.zh: 是否还有其他已签名的页？

5493d0d6f07d70d5.en: Did you authorise an officer to sign for you?
5493d0d6f07d70d5.zh: 您是否授权工作人员代您签名？

24eab060516992b7.en: Federal Bailiff Service specialist supporting review of complaints to superior officers
24eab060516992b7.zh: 协助审查向上级提出的申诉的联邦司法执行局工作人员

9589b3b916cf00cd.en: The authorised Federal Bailiff Service official reviewing a complaint to a superior officer.
9589b3b916cf00cd.zh: 有权审查上级申诉的联邦司法执行局官员。

9e01ae44f086f35b.en: Prepare the ruling on a formal defect provided for in Article 125, without deciding the complaint on the merits.
9e01ae44f086f35b.zh: 依据第125条针对形式缺陷拟定决定，而不对申诉作实体判断。

4de5b7311aac7a9d.zh: 已打印姓氏，但缺少签名

c4a86e47b7e1b5ed.en: Prepare the ruling on a formal defect provided for in Article 125, without deciding the complaint on the merits. In the base case, the complaint met the formal requirements. Here, a procedural question about its form has its own deadline; whether the underlying violation is proven is not assessed.
c4a86e47b7e1b5ed.zh: 依据第125条针对形式缺陷拟定决定，而不对申诉作实体判断。基础案例中的申诉形式符合规定。此处处理的是具有独立期限的形式程序问题，不判断所指控的实体违法是否得到证明。

a48f8b5fc772c1aa.en: A ruling refusing consideration on the merits does not prove that the bailiff’s actions were correct.
a48f8b5fc772c1aa.zh: 拒绝实体审查的决定，并不能证明执行员的行为正确。

18d616d9efd8dba5.en: Record the content and type of advertising structure
18d616d9efd8dba5.zh: 记录广告内容及广告设施的类型

c39e862103b0f374.en: Compare several applicable restrictions, not just one distance
c39e862103b0f374.zh: 核对多项适用限制，而非仅看距离

19c1ceb227a5a420.en: Prepare materials for the appropriate authorised officer
19c1ceb227a5a420.zh: 为适当的有权经办人员准备材料

c07ccc896ddf082e.en: Explain the review procedure to the applicant without prematurely announcing a sanction
c07ccc896ddf082e.zh: 向申请人说明审查程序，不提前宣布处罚

97431ac6b492ab84.en: Check whether the subsequent message concerns this structure and advertising material
97431ac6b492ab84.zh: 核查后续消息是否涉及同一广告设施及材料

a1103c805996270a.en: Revoke the shop’s licence on your own without authority
a1103c805996270a.zh: 在没有权限的情况下自行吊销商店许可证

39b36a9cde54c5ef.en: Declare the advertisement lawful based on distance alone
39b36a9cde54c5ef.zh: 仅凭距离认定广告合法

e267de0a5b200a5c.en: A freestanding outdoor billboard advertises beer. The established distance to the school is 180 metres. This is neither a winery advertisement nor a shop sign.
e267de0a5b200a5c.zh: 一块独立式户外广告牌在宣传啤酒。已确定其距学校180米。这既不是葡萄酒庄广告，也不是店铺招牌。

3a2062da7300dce7.en: Only the distance was checked. The justification did not consider the other requirements of Article 21.
3a2062da7300dce7.zh: 只核查了距离，论证中没有考虑第21条的其他要求。

fa660a93c9e1865e.en: The restriction on the placement method must be checked; 180 metres does not settle the whole issue.
fa660a93c9e1865e.zh: 必须核查发布方式的限制；180米的距离不能解决全部问题。

4068f0e0676ebc17.en: Beyond 100 metres, all forms of alcohol advertising are permitted.
4068f0e0676ebc17.zh: 超过100米后，任何形式的酒类广告都被允许。

f1f9545e908cff68.en: Beer advertising is never treated as advertising of alcoholic products.
f1f9545e908cff68.zh: 啤酒广告在任何情况下都不属于酒类产品广告。

02e182a946a446a7.en: The owner removed the large image but left the product name and an invitation to buy beer on the same billboard.
02e182a946a446a7.zh: 所有人移除了大幅图片，但在同一广告牌上保留了商品名称和购买啤酒的号召。

074dfcd1a686cf37.en: Check the remaining content instead of treating a partial change as full removal of the problem.
074dfcd1a686cf37.zh: 检查剩余内容，不把部分修改视为问题已全部消除。

bfc0fa3581b83c7c.en: Close the case because the image was removed.

8148ebc5bffae401.en: Declare any shop name to be beer advertising.
8148ebc5bffae401.zh: 认定任何商店名称都是啤酒广告。

f98a022f8052f081.en: Article 21 of Federal Law No. 38-FZ contains several independent restrictions on alcohol advertising. Meeting a distance requirement does not remove the ban on placement on outdoor advertising structures; the beer in this case does not fall within the special exception for certain winery products. The competent authority decides whether a violation occurred.
f98a022f8052f081.zh: 第38-FZ号联邦法律第21条规定了多项独立的酒类广告限制。符合距离要求并不消除在户外广告设施上发布的禁令；本案啤酒不属于某些葡萄酒庄产品的特别例外。是否构成违法由主管机关决定。

c018ff67c82ccd95.en: Find the restrictions on advertising alcoholic products by placement method.
c018ff67c82ccd95.zh: 查找按发布方式规定的酒类产品广告限制。

5b50a6017f96c512.en: There is a beer advertisement on a freestanding billboard. The owner says it is 180 metres from the school. He insists it is all legal because it is more than a hundred metres away. Are there no other conditions?
5b50a6017f96c512.zh: 一块独立广告牌上有啤酒广告。所有人说它距学校180米。他坚持认为超过一百米就完全合法。难道没有其他条件吗？

d18b1d3c91053c00.en: Checking the content and distribution method of alcoholic-product advertising
d18b1d3c91053c00.zh: 核查酒类产品广告的内容和传播方式

aed4350a725b4c0f.en: Measuring distance as the sole criterion
aed4350a725b4c0f.zh: 仅测量距离，并将其作为唯一标准

b3edd55c225860fc.en: Revocation of a shop licence by a reception officer
b3edd55c225860fc.zh: 由接待人员吊销商店许可证

274d5710ad27e175.en: A specific beer, with an image of its packaging and an invitation to buy; it is not a shop name or tourist information about a winery.
274d5710ad27e175.zh: 以包装图片和购买号召宣传某款啤酒；并非商店名称或酒庄旅游信息。

200053d263eab56f.en: The subject of the advertisement is established by the scenario.
200053d263eab56f.zh: 题设已明确广告所宣传的对象。

b692a85bbefda5cd.en: On a freestanding outdoor advertising structure.
b692a85bbefda5cd.zh: 在独立式户外广告设施上。

7363ca3f1c9016c8.en: The restriction on the placement method must be checked.
7363ca3f1c9016c8.zh: 需要核查发布方式的限制。

d8ea89fb3810fe1b.en: For this exercise, the distance is established as 180 metres; disputes about measurement are excluded.
d8ea89fb3810fe1b.zh: 本练习已确定距离为180米，不涉及测量争议。

d7ab8a3e3dc3bd62.en: Even a sufficient distance does not remove the other restrictions.
d7ab8a3e3dc3bd62.zh: 即使距离足够，也不会消除其他限制。

5758eba70a16c6ba.en: The billboard owner, referring only to the 100-metre rule.
5758eba70a16c6ba.zh: 广告牌所有人本人，只引用了100米的规则。

d27036378b6bf3a8.en: An incomplete reference does not establish that the placement is lawful.
d27036378b6bf3a8.zh: 不完整的法律引用不能证明发布行为合法。

70f2b2f8f5869796.en: Check the advertisement’s content and placement method. Do not replace the prescribed review procedure by imposing a sanction yourself.
70f2b2f8f5869796.zh: 核查广告内容和发布方式。不得以自行处罚替代规定的审查程序。

1c8f291d354206dd.en: Reception specialist at the antimonopoly authority
1c8f291d354206dd.zh: 反垄断机关接待工作人员

71f4584503283724.en: Refer the materials for review of the advertising incident, checking point 5 of Part 2 of Article 21 as it applies to this billboard.
71f4584503283724.zh: 提交材料以审查该广告事项，核查第21条第2款第5项对本广告牌的适用。

df987a53ba9ba668.en: Close the case based solely on the 180-metre distance.

eb0928c6beb4bbe5.en: Automatically prohibit trading at the neighbouring shop.
eb0928c6beb4bbe5.zh: 自动禁止旁边商店经营。

95c33073cb04e340.en: A hundred metres is not the only condition

0af67df893eb3d1e.en: Check the independent restrictions on content and placement.
0af67df893eb3d1e.zh: 核查广告内容和发布地点的独立限制。

a7eb830625d0c988.en: Assistant: ‘We checked the hundred metres, so there is no need to read any more of the law.’
a7eb830625d0c988.zh: 助手说：“一百米已经核查过了，不用再读法律了。”

5b05efcaab242300.en: Compare the classification of the material with the recorded distribution channel.
5b05efcaab242300.zh: 将材料的定性与已记录的传播渠道相对照。

32729fa9d0bed5c3.en: Distinguish restrictions on the channel, audience age and warning notice.
32729fa9d0bed5c3.zh: 分别考虑传播渠道、受众年龄和警示语的限制。

d3d5c706149e2aa5.en: Prepare relevant materials for review by the authorised body.
d3d5c706149e2aa5.zh: 准备相关材料，供有权机关审查。

353c3faf643b9241.en: Do not publish the banner as an advertisement on behalf of the game or impose a penalty yourself.
353c3faf643b9241.zh: 不要以游戏名义将横幅作为广告发布，也不要自行处罚。

d3754277e0ee3b21.en: Check the outcome concerning the identified internet publication.
d3754277e0ee3b21.zh: 核查针对所指明网络发布内容的处理结果。

6834c68747416a8b.en: Close the matter based solely on an 18+ label.

61e6a3c50510b15b.en: Impose and collect a fine yourself, without the required procedure or authority.
61e6a3c50510b15b.zh: 未经规定程序且没有权限，自行处以罚款并收取。

a98ec6f46ed451d8.en: All participants and documents in this case are fictional. The scenario classifies the material as beer advertising, not a neutral catalogue or special information about a winery. The record confirms internet placement and its date. No real brands or appealing advertising slogans are used. You prepare materials and a proposed course of action; you do not replace the authorised official’s decision. The calendar task concerns the authority’s formal response, not the actual elimination of the problem.
a98ec6f46ed451d8.zh: 本案所有参与者和文件均为虚构。题设将材料定性为啤酒广告，而非中立目录或酒庄特别信息。记录确认了网络发布及其日期。不使用真实品牌或具有吸引力的广告口号。您的任务是准备材料和行动建议，而不是替代有权官员作决定。日期计算任务针对机关的正式答复，并非实际消除问题的时间。

6ee50a7802709cb5.en: The base version examined the location of outdoor placement. Here, the internet channel matters independently, not the distance to a school.
6ee50a7802709cb5.zh: 基础版本核查的是户外发布地点。此处具有独立意义的是互联网渠道，而非与学校的距离。

07a7796f15ac81b0.en: The characteristics of beer advertising and its placement on a website page have been confirmed. The material is accessible online; it is not a photograph of an internal price list attached to an appeal.
07a7796f15ac81b0.zh: 已确认材料具有啤酒广告特征，并发布在网站页面上。该材料可通过互联网访问，并非诉求中附带的内部价目表照片。

fb61a606a1352e20.en: The distributor points to the 18+ label and warning. These elements are indeed present; no other circumstances affecting the classification or channel have been provided.
fb61a606a1352e20.zh: 发布方指出存在18+标识和警示语。这些元素确实存在，但未提供会改变材料定性或传播渠道的其他情况。

1ac692d5aeb8de48.en: The certificate states the distance to the school building. It does not change the established internet distribution channel.
1ac692d5aeb8de48.zh: 证明中注明了距学校建筑的距离，但这不会改变已确定的互联网传播渠道。

d6b6c39dcf07fa68.en: Measurement of the distance to the school

4aafa1269d184abe.en: An age label does not remove the independent restriction on online alcohol advertising. The base version examined the location of outdoor placement. Here, the internet channel matters independently, not the distance to a school.
4aafa1269d184abe.zh: 年龄标识不会消除对互联网酒类广告的独立限制。基础版本核查的是户外发布地点。此处具有独立意义的是互联网渠道，而非与学校的距离。

5b35d98c5c365457.en: An age label does not remove the independent restriction on online alcohol advertising.
5b35d98c5c365457.zh: 年龄标识不会消除对互联网酒类广告的独立限制。

3dcdb009c330b243.en: Any 18+ label makes alcohol advertising permissible in every channel.
3dcdb009c330b243.zh: 任何18+标识都能使酒类广告在所有渠道上合法发布。

b754e9cdee568ae9.en: Distance to a school is the only condition for any beer advertising.
b754e9cdee568ae9.zh: 与学校的距离是任何啤酒广告的唯一条件。

670f981a05d72b0a.en: Monitoring cannot be limited to one address when a second publication has been established.
670f981a05d72b0a.zh: 已确定存在第二处发布内容时，核查不能仅限于一个地址。

19d9531e7016b6c2.en: The distributor removed the banner from one page, but a separate publication at another address on the same website has been confirmed.
19d9531e7016b6c2.zh: 发布方从一个页面移除了横幅，但已确认同一网站的另一地址还存在独立发布的相同内容。

918d98ed0a0e9f9f.en: Compare the scope of the review with the remaining publication and forward a clarification.
918d98ed0a0e9f9f.zh: 将审查范围与仍然存在的发布内容相对照，并转交补充说明。

edb54c7c2413215b.en: Treat removal of one copy as proof that no publications remain.
edb54c7c2413215b.zh: 将删除一个副本视为全部发布内容均已不存在的证明。

d2ce1cb594fb393f.en: Post a copy of the banner in the game’s public feed for discussion.
d2ce1cb594fb393f.zh: 将横幅副本发布到游戏的公开动态中供讨论。

a6fe3d499beb7534.en: Article 21 of Federal Law No. 38-FZ sets different restrictions on the content, method and location of alcohol advertising. Point 8 of Part 2 prohibits placing such advertising on the internet; an 18+ label does not remove that prohibition. Part 3 requires a warning about the harm of excessive consumption covering at least 10 percent of the advertising space. Meeting one condition does not remove the others. The tasks concern beer, not special advertising for wineries.
a6fe3d499beb7534.zh: 第38-FZ号联邦法律第21条分别规定了酒类广告在内容、方式和地点方面的限制。第2款第8项禁止在互联网上发布此类广告；18+标识不会消除该禁令。第3款要求过量饮用有害的警示语占据至少10%的广告面积。满足一项条件并不免除其他要求。题目涉及啤酒，而非酒庄的特别广告。

fff90025ddd5c590.en: Check the prohibition on internet placement separately from the other conditions of Article 21.
fff90025ddd5c590.zh: 分别核查互联网发布禁令和第21条的其他条件。

997a69cdf4c92e74.en: Limit the check to the age label.

ed401751f18b2004.en: Treat distance to a school as universal permission.
ed401751f18b2004.zh: 将与学校的距离视为普遍许可。

d941ed623077b008.en: Find the provision: independent restrictions on alcohol advertising. Give the instrument’s identifying details and article, then select the applicable provision.
d941ed623077b008.zh: 查找法律规范：酒类广告的独立限制。注明法规的识别信息和条文，再选择适用规定。

3608c82872170947.en: A beer advertisement was placed online with an 18+ label above it. The representative believes that this is sufficient.
3608c82872170947.zh: 啤酒广告被发布到互联网上，上方标有18+。代理人认为这样就足够了。

08186319aeeeeb60.en: Preparing a review under the specific restriction in advertising law.
08186319aeeeeb60.zh: 依据广告法律中的具体限制准备审查。

669a6393511a69d7.en: Checking only the distance to a school instead of the established distribution channel.
669a6393511a69d7.zh: 只核查与学校的距离，而不核查已确定的传播渠道。

5f3296dd2ca12b94.en: Automatic imposition of a fine by a reception specialist.
5f3296dd2ca12b94.zh: 由接待工作人员自动作出罚款决定。

d11c838fba90acd3.en: An advertising banner highlighting a specific beer and encouraging a purchase; its classification is established by the materials.
d11c838fba90acd3.zh: 突出某款啤酒并鼓励购买的广告横幅；材料已确定其性质。

7722c0210021d245.en: The subject is specifically the advertising of alcoholic products.
7722c0210021d245.zh: 该事项明确涉及酒类产品广告。

c5c9bc9209a9c7ce.en: The placement channel has been established.

4ed4fe30911754f1.en: The presence of an 18+ label and a warning.
4ed4fe30911754f1.zh: 以存在18+标识和警示语为依据。

87e867f55fddac2e.en: The other elements do not remove the channel restriction.
87e867f55fddac2e.zh: 其他元素不会消除渠道限制。

241f3d6ab982c310.en: What is the justification for claiming it is permissible?
241f3d6ab982c310.zh: 据什么理由认为可以发布？

aebb450230021893.en: The authorised body after the prescribed procedure.
aebb450230021893.zh: 由有权机关在履行规定程序后决定。

b82669acbd4a814c.en: The reception office prepares materials; it does not impose sanctions.
b82669acbd4a814c.zh: 接待处负责准备材料，不负责作出处罚。

c7159f24fe3e9cbf.en: Who decides whether a violation occurred?

84c2a5a25baf2cc9.en: Specialist preparing materials at the antimonopoly authority
84c2a5a25baf2cc9.zh: 反垄断机关材料准备工作人员

30239091324b3d42.en: The competent unit of the antimonopoly authority, following the prescribed procedure.
30239091324b3d42.zh: 由反垄断机关的主管部门按规定程序处理。

877287bbf7ed2f08.en: The school council as the body permitting online alcohol advertising.
877287bbf7ed2f08.zh: 由学校理事会作为批准互联网酒类广告的机关。

f81dfa78d569342c.en: The age-labelling operator instead of the supervisory authority.
f81dfa78d569342c.zh: 由年龄标识运营方代替监管机关。

386deb8c4b86735d.en: An age label does not change the channel
386deb8c4b86735d.zh: 年龄标识不会改变传播渠道

788f5fe1dfee078d.en: The conditions are checked independently; the presence of one element does not remove another restriction.
788f5fe1dfee078d.zh: 各项条件需要分别核查；存在一个元素并不能消除另一项限制。

d1224d8ada23bd85.en: A harm warning and an 18+ label, by themselves, remove the prohibition on the specific channel.
d1224d8ada23bd85.zh: 危害警示和18+标识本身就能消除对特定渠道的禁令。

5d7a4c3c3c2bc985.en: Compare the contents of the list with the context in which it is displayed.
5d7a4c3c3c2bc985.zh: 将清单内容与其展示情境相对照。

36dbec62738e8bf1.en: Record the mandatory informational nature of this particular material.
36dbec62738e8bf1.zh: 记录该特定材料具有法定信息告知性质。

d84146b4cf567881.en: Prepare a response on whether advertising law applies, without extending the conclusion.
d84146b4cf567881.zh: 拟定关于广告法律是否适用的答复，不扩大结论范围。

a8ccae421e4a2ab7.en: Do not blame the applicant or promise that all other activities of the establishment are lawful.
a8ccae421e4a2ab7.zh: 不要指责申请人，也不要保证该场所的其他一切行为都合法。

139a7efc37c0bee5.en: Check that the response concerns list И-6, rather than another advertising material.
139a7efc37c0bee5.zh: 核查答复针对的是清单И-6，而非其他广告材料。
